name: Arizona Truck Driver
summary:
🚚 Explore. Deliver. Earn. Grow. Build your trucking dream in Truck Simulator Arizona!

Climb into the cab and experience the full trucker life in VR. Explore a huge world inspired by Arizona, from long desert highways and major cities to scenic routes, changing weather, and unexpected road situations.
